reviews.text:
My beloved family members are under the care of Dr. Matsuda 🐶🐶🐶

If someone asks me, "Do you know of a good vet?", I would recommend Mojamoja Animal Hospital without hesitation!

Dr. Matsuda doesn't just examine the symptoms; he carefully considers each animal's personality, usual behavior, age, and health condition, working with you to determine "what is best for this animal."

I feel very reassured that he doesn't rely solely on one treatment method, but instead incorporates acupuncture and herbal medicine as needed, considering the most appropriate approach for each individual animal.

And what I appreciate most is the genuine love that Dr. Matsuda and all the staff have for animals.

Because these animals can't speak, they carefully listen to even the smallest anxieties that owners feel, such as "something's different" or "I'm a little worried," and address them with care.

For me, who has three dogs under his care, Mojamoja Animal Hospital is more than just a place to go when they're sick.

This is a place where you'll want to consult with them for years to come, from when your pet is healthy to as they grow older.

I know many people struggle to choose a veterinary hospital because it concerns their beloved family member.

This is a veterinary hospital I would definitely like those people to know about. ☺️

My little ones and I look forward to continuing our relationship with you for many years to come.

★★★★★

This is a truly trustworthy animal hospital where I can confidently entrust my beloved family member (Kurumi-chan).

There are many animal hospitals, but finding one where you can truly feel at ease is not easy.

At Mojamoja Animal Hospital, the doctor and staff are all very warm and, above all, they treat each animal with genuine care.

The examinations are not just about looking at the symptoms; they also carefully consider the animal's personality, condition, and even the owner's anxieties, and their explanations are thorough and easy to understand.

They don't rely solely on Western medicine, but also incorporate Eastern medicine such as acupuncture and herbal medicine when necessary, considering treatments that are as stress-free as possible for each animal, which gives me great peace of mind.

Because animals cannot speak, "who you take care of them" is truly important.

Since coming here, I've realized how reassuring it is to have a doctor I can consult with when something happens.

The hospital's name, "Mojamoja," is certainly memorable, but the sentiment behind it—"facing each and every little life"—is clearly conveyed through the actual treatments and the staff's demeanor.

I would confidently recommend this hospital to anyone looking for a place where they can entrust their beloved pet, who is like family, with peace of mind.

It's a wonderful animal hospital that I would like to continue using for many years to come.

After bringing our puppy home, we visited Mojamoja Animal Hospital for the first time for a rabies vaccination.

We went there intending to get the rabies shot, but during the examination, several items were added that we hadn't requested, including ear examinations, stool tests, ear treatments, and medications.

The detailed bill included:
* Initial consultation fee: 4,400 yen
* Medical record creation fee: 1,100 yen
* Rabies vaccine: 3,300 yen
The final bill was just under 25,000 yen.

While it's possible that some of the tests and treatments were necessary, we were concerned that the hospital proceeded with tests and treatments we hadn't requested without explaining their necessity or confirming any additional charges.

Afterward, we also visited Heart Animal Hospital, where the initial consultation fee was 2,000 yen, nail trimming was 800 yen, ear treatment was 1,200 yen, anal gland treatment was 800 yen, and the 5-in-1 vaccine was 7,000 yen, for a total of 12,980 yen.

Of course, I understand that fees and services vary from hospital to hospital. I'm not just looking to compare prices; if they're going to perform tests or procedures I didn't request, I'd appreciate it if they explained what they're going to do, why it's necessary, and how much extra it will cost beforehand, so I can understand and agree to it.

I've just welcomed a puppy into my home, and I'll be relying on veterinary care in the future, so I want to choose a hospital I can trust and feel comfortable consulting with.

I felt very taken advantage of, and I was quite disappointed with this visit.

They examine my pet thoroughly, which puts me at ease. Some people say it's expensive because of the after-hours fee, but I think it's about what you'd expect for a veterinary clinic in Minato Ward. I was looking for a new veterinary clinic after Dr. Mori retired, so I'm glad I found a good one. They also offer acupuncture, so I'd like to try that next time.

I've been going to this hospital because I've known the director since my previous hospital visits.

Dr. Matsuda and all the nurses are very kind, so I feel completely at ease entrusting my pet to them.

I trust Dr. Matsuda very much because he examines my pet with such care and attention to even the smallest details.

The new hospital is bright and sunny, which seems to put my dog ​​at ease.
My dog ​​is getting healthier after receiving acupuncture and moxibustion treatments.
Everyone, from Director Matsuda to the staff, is incredibly kind and courteous. 💖 …

This is an all-female veterinary hospital.
I'm always looked after by kind, polite, and accurate doctors.
The reception staff are also very helpful, so I feel at ease leaving my pets in their care.

We went to several other hospitals, but now Mojamoja Hospital is our go-to.
The doctor is kind to the animals, and his explanations are very easy to understand.
All of our pets love the doctor and the staff.
